alternatives_rejected.why: Its error spike in E1 lines up with the 0->0.51 errors that callers of recommendationservice see in E2. That makes frontend a downstream symptom, not the source.

Own-span self-time rose only 2.46x and inbound self-time only 1.11x (E2). Pure delay would not produce the 0.51 caller-observed error rate. Lost packets causing failed or timed-out calls explains both the errors and the inflated latency percentiles in E3.

The socket deviation in E3 (z=86.98) is much smaller than the latency deviation (z=773). It is consistent with retransmissions and retries under loss. Exhaustion would normally show up as errors inside the service's own spans, but E2 records 0.0 there.

proposed_fix.description: Inspect and remove the network impairment on recommendationservice's pod/interface, e.g. any tc/netem loss rule or a faulty sidecar or CNI path. If the cause is unclear, restart or reschedule the recommendationservice pod onto a healthy node, then verify that frontend error rates return to baseline.
